verdict.rationale: Fellow's own materials make only an unquantified marketing claim of "human-level accuracy" and say transcripts are diarized and timestamped. That is barely more than "AI-powered": there is no documentation of the underlying speech models, measured accuracy or methodology, or known limitations. Missing for 10: named transcription models/providers, quantified accuracy metrics (e.g., WER) with methodology, documented known limits (languages, accents, audio conditions, speaker count), independent corroboration.
